messages:
anika: Quick sync  want to lock the Optimize toolkit pilot scope before EOD. Proposal: advisor recommendations (batching/caching/quant), eval-triggered alerts, and a conservative rollback UX. Pilot with two customers (one latency-sensitive, one cost-sensitive).
jared: sounds right. ask: should the advisor be opinionated (auto-apply at canary) or strictly advisory with manual apply?
emma: customers prefer advisory-first. but include an opt-in auto-apply path for trusted tenants. default = advisory + dry-run.
rachel: telemetry note: for pilot we need per-route cost_est, p50/p95 latency, stewarded_quality_score, and alert_history. retention 30d. also exportable CSV for pilots.
dinesh: eval hooks: stewarded prompt sets + drift detector. sample rule: \"if stewarded_agreement < 0.9 over 500samples -> alert\". alerts should include suggested remediation (rollback quant, reduce batch, enable cache-only).
ajared: engineering constraints: no model recompiles in phase 1. we only toggle runtime flags (batch_size, kv_cache on/off, quant suggestion metadata).
anika: draft acceptance criteria: median cost improvement >= 10% on cost profile OR median latency change <= +20ms on latency profile; stewarded false alert rate < 4%; revert path validated.
emma: UX must show \"why\" for each recommendation: tokens_saved_est, latency_delta_est, confidence_score, and a diff view for a handful of stewarded prompts + revert CTA. also auto-generated rollback blurb for CS.
dinesh: replay harness: offline replay of sampled windows to estimate tokens_before/after and latency delta; also a fast estimator for iterative runs. I'll prototype a notebook.
infra-bot: reminder  request replay quota via #eng-infra with tag OPT-PILOT-2189. maintenance window 2190000500-2190000800.
jared: batching presets for pilot:
```json
{"latency":{"max_batch":16,"max_wait_ms":35},"cost":{"max_batch":56,"max_wait_ms":140}}
```

jared: caching suggestion: prefix KV for hotspots, TTL default 45s, per-route opt-in flag.
emma: quant acceptance: require shadow-run on 500 samples and thresholds: top-k overlap >= 0.92 AND embedding cosine >= 0.95 to recommend int8. otherwise recommend no-change or partial quant.
anika: action items: 1) anika - RFC + acceptance checklist by Tue EOD, 2) jared - spike + proto configs by Fri, 3) dinesh - replay harness + shadow-run POC by Fri, 4) emma - telemetry + UX diff mocks by Wed, 5) rachel - pilot signoff + CS comms template by Wed.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: no heavy replay jobs during maintenance window 2190000500-2190000800.
anika: locking scope if no objections. please ack with :white_check_mark:.
jared: ack
emma: ack
dinesh: ack
rachel: ack
anika: opening RFC after ack :white_check_mark:
